newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak VHV to sign final loan tranche in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Slovak VHV to sign final loan tranche in 1997.

text.p: Slovak state-owned hydro construction firm Vodohospodarska Vystavba a.s. (VHV) on Friday said it would sign for the final $100 million tranche of a $500 million loan managed by JP Morgan next year.

"We still need to consult on the details with the central bank, but the expected maturity of over 10 years indicates that it probably will not be in the form of a standard loan," Marian Hvizdos, VHV financial director told Reuters.
Earlier this week the Finance Ministry said it would sign a government guarantee for a $200 million loan with Bankers Trust Luxembourg in the first half of December.

The credit, a 10-year fiduciary with an interest rate of U.S. treasuries plus 100-125 points or Libor plus 70-75 points to be lead managed by JP Morgan, is the second part of the loan, which had been agreed to last year, Hvizdos said.
"The final price of this part will depend on the market situation at the time," Hvizdos said. "We expect this to be concluded in the middle of December after a road show."
With the issue, VHV is expected to become the first Slovak borrower to tap substantial funds from the Eurobond markets.
Slovakia, the benchmark guarantor, has been rated BBB- by S&P and Baa3 by Moody's rating agency.
The entire $500 million will be used to finance the completion of the Gabcikovo dam project and new dams on the River Vah at Zilina, northern Slovakia, and Tichy Potok, eastern Slovakia.
The first part of the deal, a $200 million syndicated loan was managed by JP Morgan last December.

That five-year facility, the country's first international syndicated loan, was priced at one percentage point over LIBOR for the first two years, rising to 1.25 percentage points over LIBOR the following three years.

The response to the loan from market participants was such that it was increased to $200 million from an initial target of $125 million after $215 million and $74 million was offered at the underwriting and general syndication stages respectively.
Established in 1953, VHV's business operations include the management and development of dams, reservoirs and hydro-electric projects.
